versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill.
- Auto-adapts teaching style, format, and depth based on how you learn best.
- Detects and confirms learning preferences from user interactions (minimum 2 consistent signals).
- Supports academic, professional, and casual learning contexts.
- Built-in guardrails to protect sensitive personal and demographic data; only behavioral preferences are recorded.
- Preferences for style, format, tools, and avoidances are updated dynamically as you learn.
